data: Which of the following describes the runtime trend of morpheme mining with increased vocabulary size?

The runtime trend of morpheme mining increases with an increase in vocabulary size. The runtime for morpheme mining is significantly higher than that for morpheme segmentation across all vocabulary sizes shown in the graph. As the vocabulary size increases, both the runtime for morpheme mining and morpheme segmentation increase, but the increase in runtime for morpheme mining is more pronounced compared to morpheme segmentation.
